script_core: Turn new reputation into a real pipeline
pitch_headline: A SuperSite built to turn fresh trust into steady opportunity.
pitch_body: This version of the SuperSite is tuned for newer companies with unusually strong early reviews. The goal is to make that early reputation feel more established and more useful.
section_title: A SuperSite that helps a newer company look ready now.
section_copy: When the review profile is strong but still new, the site should bridge the gap between early trust and a more mature first impression.
video_section_title: The finished result still needs to feel real.
video_section_body: A short transformation clip helps a newer brand feel more grounded by showing the kind of outcome homeowners already care about.

why_cards.title: Fresh trust, better presented
why_cards.body: A younger company can feel more established when the review proof is framed properly.

why_cards.title: Stronger first impression
why_cards.body: The SuperSite helps early momentum feel intentional instead of accidental.

why_cards.title: Pipeline support
why_cards.body: The point is not just to look better. It is to give that early trust a clearer path into real inquiries.
